name: TCM-BASE pilot dataset v0.1
description: Pilot dataset and reference benchmark supporting the development of AI agents for building a thermochemical heat-storage materials knowledge base. It contains material records extracted from a small corpus of peer-reviewed papers under a fixed schema, a set of bibliographic records screened against explicit inclusion criteria, and the protocols, manual reference annotation and validation workbooks used to measure how reliably the two underlying tasks — literature identification and data extraction — can be automated. The pilot benchmarks the language-model core on which such agents are built, in single-pass, schema-constrained runs; orchestration, tool use and self-verification belong to subsequent work. Every value keeps the unit used in its source publication and carries sentence-level provenance. Source article PDFs are not included (publisher copyright); the corpus is identified by DOI. Files are restricted while the associated research proposals are under evaluation. Produced at CETHIL (INSA Lyon / CNRS).
